summary_1line: Multiple duels erupt around Bhishma as warriors on both sides—Satyaki, Abhimanyu, Bhima, and others—clash with Kaurava champions seeking to protect the grandsire.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki splits Bhagadatta’s jewel-studded iron dart midair with a flurry of arrows, the shattered weapon falling like a dim meteor.
Bhima stands on his chariot with a golden-winged arrow lodged in his chest, still firing blazing shafts at Bhurisravas.
Old kings Virata and Drupada charge together toward Bhishma while Ashwatthaman showers them with arrows.
